context: Request: has the firm ever set up a fund using an American (deal-by-deal) waterfall? No matter is named; the single criterion requires stating that no fund the firm set up uses one.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus three content greps for request keywords and a listing of one candidate matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads agreement drafts, a structuring memo and two emails of one candidate matter.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Content grep inside that matter for specific section and entity names.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads two further sections of one agreement draft.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Glob for a keyword in file names.
Lists three other candidate matters and tries two reads (one guessed path).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads several sections of another matter's agreement and one more agreement draft.
Writes that no instance was found for one client's funds and declines to state a firm-wide answer.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The conclusion was scoped to one client and declined to answer for the firm as asked.

first_error.why: Having reviewed several fund matters, it framed the conclusion around one client and explicitly declined the firm-wide statement the question asked for.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads five memos and emails from the matters at the top of the listing in full (limit 1000); about 320K chars.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script with broad terms prints about 7.4M chars; the run stops with the context full, before any response is written.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: An unbounded scan dump filled the context; no response.md was produced.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Ran a store-wide scan with broad terms and no output cap; its 7.4M-char output overflowed the context and the run ended without a deliverable.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a content grep for request keywords.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction scan; times out with about 36K chars of hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads four documents of one candidate matter.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two more reads in the same matter alongside a store-wide .docx content grep that returns nothing (labelled by the store-wide search).
Writes that no evidence was found that the firm ever did so, citing the one matter whose draft moved the other way.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file contents for request keywords → Write the response → Finish the run

divergence: T2 scanned, read one candidate matter and stated a flat firm-wide 'no evidence we have'. T0 searched and read more candidate matters than T2 but scoped its conclusion to one client and declined the firm-wide answer; T1 read huge files from the capped listing, then ran an uncapped scan whose 7.4M-char output overflowed the context before any response was written.
